attempts.summary: On node1, deployed inventory-api as a systemd-managed service (inventory-api.service) with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, enabled and running on port 8080 via $NODE_IP. Verified the kernel's global OOM killer, when driven out of memory by an unprotected memory-hog process (oom_score_adj=0), selects and kills the hog while inventory-api keeps serving without interruption (same PID before/after). Confirmed this behavior both before and after a full node reboot, and proved the reboot actually occurred via a changed boot_id and fresh uptime.
